item.title: Java 25 Security: Key Derivation Function API & PEM Encodings
item.description: Overview Java 25 ships two important security additions: JEP 510 — Key Derivation Function (KDF) API — Final. A standard API for HKDF, PBKDF2, and other KDFs. JEP 470 — PEM Encodings of Cryptographic Objects — Preview. Read and write .pem files without third-party libraries. These fill two long-standing gaps: Java had the underlying crypto but no clean standard API for key derivation and PEM I/O. Part 1: Key Derivation Function API (JEP 510) What Is Key Derivation?
